## Shell side (m1-tauri-attach)

- `src-tauri` runs `LiveIngest` (core, `ingest::watch::live`) on an `ingest` thread; commands: `open_replay{path}`, `list_missions`, `open_mission{mission_id}`,
  `mission_sessions{mission_id}`, `list_sessions`, `attach{session_id}`, `board{mission_id, filter?, grouping?, at?}` (a `BoardDigest`), `event_raw{event_id}`. Events:
  `events_appended` (EventBatch), `session_discovered` (SessionRow), `attach_status` (AttachStatus). Arguments use snake_case keys.
- App log (stdout, UTC RFC 3339): `ingest_started`, `session_discovered session_id= path= name=`, `attach_status watched= unwatched=`, `events_appended mission_id= count= unknown_total=`,
  `WARN TooLarge path= mb=` (once per file).
- A growing file is read every `event_batch_ms` for one poll interval after the last line read (the notifier misses writes of a handle the writer keeps open). A new session is found within
  `jsonl_poll_ms` + `event_batch_ms`.
- Events that only a finished session gives (`usage.reported` from the sidecar) are stored when the app exits normally (`RunEvent::Exit`); a signal-killed app lacks them. Live event count = CLI `replay --root-only`
  count minus those (M0 root: 473 live vs 474 replay).
- `scripts/tests/attach-smoke.sh [latency|limit|toolarge]` runs the built `observatory-app` binary against a temp sessions dir and `OBSERVATORY_CONFIG`; it does not need `trunk serve`.
